newsitem.title: USA: CIMA LABS in pact with Schering.
newsitem.headline: CIMA LABS in pact with Schering.

text.p: CIMA Labs Inc said Tuesday it signed an exclusive agreement with Schering Corp to develop a fast dissolve formulation of a sustained release prescription product. The product was not identified.
Schering Corp is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Schering-Plough Corp.
In exchange for its development work and a license option, CIMA will receive an option fee and development fees.

"We are excited to announce our first corporate partner for the combination of a sustained release prescription drug with our fast dissolve technology," said John Siebert, CIMA president and chief executive officer in a statement.
"This agreement tracks our corporate goal to develop relationships in the prescription marketplace," he added.
CIMA's OraSolv is a patented oral dosage form which incorporates microencapsulated drug ingredients into tablets that dissolve quickly in the mouth.
CIMA develops and makes drug delivery technology.
